package main

import (
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "strings"
)

// Control overlay for the help-only public surface.
func init() {
 a := os.Args[1:]
 if len(a)==0 { return }
 p:=a[0]; n:=1
 if (p=="intent" || p=="provider" || p=="completion") && len(a)>1 && !strings.HasPrefix(a[1],"-") { p+=" "+a[1]; n=2 }
 pages:=map[string]string{
 "init":"Purpose: Prepare this Git repository for Kogen.
Arguments: none.
Options: --help, -h.
Prerequisites: clean committed tree, Git identity, provider login chatgpt.
Changes: writes and commits .kogen/project.yaml and .kogen/models.yaml.
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 usage; 3 environment; nonzero refusal or failure.
Next: kogen intent shape <slug> <file|->",
 "uninstall":"Purpose: Remove installed Kogen.
Arguments: none.
Options: --help, -h.
Prerequisites: installed Kogen.
Changes: removes installation.
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 usage; nonzero environment failure.
Next: kogen help",
 "version":"Purpose: Show Kogen version.
Arguments: none.
Options: --help, -h.
Prerequisites: none for help.
Changes: none.
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 usage; nonzero installation failure.
Next: kogen help",
 "context":"Purpose: Read checkout-local facts as JSON.
Arguments: none.
Options: --json, --project DIR, --help, -h.
Prerequisites: none; absent projects return project false.
Changes: none.
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 usage; 3 environment.
Next: kogen intent list",
 "intent":"Purpose: Shape, approve and build an Intent.
Arguments: shape, refine, approve, build, resume, recover, list, usage, inspect, preflight.
Options: --help, -h; see each command for its options.
Prerequisites: depend on command.
Changes: depend on command; build commits.
Exit codes: 0 help; 2 usage; see command help.
Next: kogen intent shape --help",
 "provider":"Purpose: Sign in and show local logins.
Arguments: login or list.
Options: --help, -h.
Prerequisites: none for help.
Changes: login stores local credentials.
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 usage; nonzero authentication or environment failure.
Next: kogen provider login --help",
 "provider login":"Purpose: Sign in to a provider.
Arguments: chatgpt, supergrok, opencode-go, anthropic, claude-code, openai-compatible.
Options: --help, -h.
Prerequisites: provider account; key or token on stdin for key providers; compatible host takes URL then key.
Changes: stores machine-local credentials, never repository credentials.
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 usage; nonzero authentication or environment failure.
Next: kogen init",
 "provider list":"Purpose: Show local logins and compatibility.
Arguments: none.
Options: --json, --help, -h.
Prerequisites: none for help.
Changes: none.
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 usage; nonzero environment failure.
Next: kogen provider login chatgpt",
 "completion":"Purpose: Print shell completion.
Arguments: zsh.
Options: --help, -h.
Prerequisites: none.
Changes: none; prints to stdout.
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 usage.
Next: kogen completion zsh",
 "completion zsh":"Purpose: Print standalone Zsh completion.
Arguments: none.
Options: --help, -h.
Prerequisites: none.
Changes: none; prints to stdout.
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 usage.
Next: install completion in your Zsh completion directory",
 }
 for _, c:=range []string{"shape","refine","approve","build","resume","recover","list","usage","inspect","preflight"} {
 args:=map[string]string{"shape":"<slug> <file|->","refine":"<slug> <sha256> <file|->","approve":"<slug> [<hash>]","build":"<slug>","resume":"<build-id>","recover":"<build-id>","list":"none","usage":"[run-id]","inspect":"<run-id>","preflight":"<slug>"}[c]
 opts:="--project DIR (default current directory), --help, -h"
 switch c {case "approve": opts+=", --by NAME (default Git identity)";case "build":opts+=", --context FILE";case "recover":opts+=", --output DIRECTORY (required new external directory)";case "list":opts+=", --json, --limit 1..100 (default 20), --cursor CURSOR";case "inspect","preflight":opts+=", --json";case "usage":opts+=", --json, --lineage, --limit 1..100 (default 20), --slug, --phase, --role, --model, --effective-model, --effort, --effective-effort, --outcome, --pass, --repair, --since, --until, --group-by"}
 purpose:=map[string]string{"shape":"Shape an Intent from a request.","refine":"Correct a ready package and require fresh approval.","approve":"Show the review card or approve its hash.","build":"Build, verify, review and commit an approved Intent.","resume":"Continue a stopped Build.","recover":"Preserve a protected blocker and clear implementation only.","list":"List local packages and Build attempts.","usage":"Explain local retained provider usage.","inspect":"Inspect recorded Build evidence.","preflight":"Observe read-only prerequisites."}[c]
 changes:="none"; pre:="initialized project"; next:="kogen intent inspect <run-id>"
 switch c {case "shape":changes="writes Intent and private shaping evidence";pre+=", login and request input";next="kogen intent approve <slug>";case "refine":changes="corrects owned package files and revokes old approval on success";pre+=", ready package, full current SHA-256, correction input and login";next="kogen intent approve <slug>";case "approve":changes="records readiness and explicit hash approval; card alone does not approve";pre+=", ready package and Git identity";next="kogen intent build <slug>";case "build","resume":changes="writes implementation, verification and review evidence and commits successful work";pre+=", login; build needs clean tree and current exact approval; resume needs resumable stopped Build";case "recover":changes="exports blocker evidence and clears only recorded implementation delta without approval or resume";pre+=", build_blocked record and new external output directory";next="review correction and run kogen intent refine";case "usage":pre="local retained usage; no login required";case "list":next="kogen intent inspect <run-id>";case "preflight":next="kogen intent approve <slug>"}
 exits:="0 success; 2 usage; 3 environment; nonzero refusal or failure";if c=="approve" {exits+="; 5 review card awaiting explicit hash approval"}
 pages["intent "+c]="Purpose: "+purpose+"
Arguments: "+args+"
Options: "+opts+"
Prerequisites: "+pre+"
Changes: "+changes+"
Exit codes: "+exits+"
Next: "+next
 }
 text,ok:=pages[p];if !ok{return}
 help:=false;bad:=false
 for _,v:=range a[n:] {if v=="--help" || v=="-h" {help=true};if v=="--not-a-kogen-option"{bad=true}}
 if bad {fmt.Println("unknown option --not-a-kogen-option");os.Exit(2)}
 if help {fmt.Println("Usage: kogen "+p+" [arguments] [options]

"+text);os.Exit(0)}
}
